bands.effect: Curiosity: questions and invitations; +2 standing with curious NPCs.
Talk: the tavern discusses the stranger's tricks; rumors carry the player's description; merchants get pushy.
Wrong-kind attention: the player becomes a mark for petty theft through normal theft rules.
Dangerous attention: criminal opportunity activates (kidnap threats, coercion attempts) through normal NPC decision rules. Emergent, never scripted.

distanceBands.reason: Across the square, at the next stall.

Beyond the village core; only the loudest events.

perception.formula: chance = clamp(distanceBand * light * attention * loudness + (cautious - 50) * 0.2 + (curious - 50) * 0.1 [novel events only], 0, 95)

hiddenDiscovery.note: No scripted discovery; chance compounds over days (Corvin vs. Piotr's savings).

standingThresholds.note: Below 30 shopkeepers watch and tabs are refused; below 20 the tavern goes quiet; above 60 doors open.
